playbookOutputs: CIPC CoR21.1 confirmation of change of registered address
Updated CoR14.3 / disclosure certificate showing the new address
playbookCommonFailures: Proof of new address is a residential utility bill in a director's name with no link to the company
Postal address left blank or entered as the old address, so the register is only half updated
Company has outstanding annual returns and CIPC blocks the change
The new address is a PO Box — CIPC requires a physical street address for the registered office

informationToProvide.label: Company registration document (COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, CK1, CK2 or MOI document showing company registration number, registered enterprise name and current registered address.

informationToProvide.label: Confirmation of new address - any statement / invoice as proof
alternatives: Signed lease agreement for the new premises
informationToProvide.aiHint: A statement, invoice, lease or utility bill showing the new physical street address, dated within 3 months. Ideally in the company's name; a director's proof of address is acceptable where the registered office is the director's home. Extract the full street address, suburb, town and postal code.

informationToProvide.label: New postal address (if different from the physical address)
informationToProvide.helpText: Leave blank if the postal address is the same as the new physical address.

informationToProvide.label: Effective Date of Registered Address Change & Director Contact Email/Cellphone
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the effective date for the new registered address (note: CIPC CoR 21.1 requires the effective date to be at least 5 business days after filing or as permitted on e-Services) and a director email/cellphone.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect company document and proof of new address
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, proof of the new physical address and the postal address received; effective date confirmed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask whether the postal address also changes and from what date the new registered office applies. Explain that CIPC needs a physical street address (not a PO Box) for the registered office. Note that by law the change takes effect five business days after filing — hence the 1-5 working day turnaround; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify address proof and company status
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Proof of address passes; address parsed into CIPC fields; company status 'In Business'
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract street number, street, suburb/complex, town, province and 4-digit postal code from the proof. Confirm the company status on CIPC — outstanding annual returns block the CoR21 transaction; propose Annual Returns first if so. If the proof is not in the company's name, note the link (director's residence) on the handoff notes.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File change of registered address (CoR21.1) on CIPC e-Services
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Address change staged with physical and postal address; Kevin has submitted and the tracking number is saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Transact > Company Address Change (CoR21.1). Capture the physical (registered office) address and postal address separately, plus the effective date. Upload the proof of address if the screen asks for supporting documents. ⚠ verify: whether CIPC currently charges a fee for CoR21 (understood to be free). Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to process the address change
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR21.1 confirmation received and the new address appears on the register
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the tracking number on e-Services before following up. On rejection, quote the reason to Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR21.1 confirmation and updated CoR14.3
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation and re-downloaded CoR14.3 posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Remind the client to update the address with SARS (eFiling registered particulars), the bank, CSD and any licences — CIPC does not push the change to SARS automatically.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
